Pradolongo — Madrid, Spain

🟡 Local press research

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Pradolongo park has extensive, repeated press coverage over nearly a decade documenting it as a safety hotspot, called 'the most dangerous park in Madrid' in 2015-2016 reports. Violent robbery-related stabbings have continued since: a 16-year-old was stabbed there in December 2022, and in December 2024 two teenagers stabbed a 45-year-old man during a daylight (around 5pm) robbery attempt. The city responded by installing 14 AI-monitored security cameras in late 2025. Sources checked: Telemadrid, 2015 & 2016; Zona Retiro, Dec 2022; El Espanol, Dec 2024; Telemadrid, Dec 2025 (new cameras).
